message:
Hey friends! 😊 I’ve been diving into some great resources about how to handle power outages, and I came across a gem that really lays out practical tips. It’s all about staying calm and prepared, which I find is the key to enjoying those unexpected moments—like a cozy candlelit dinner or a starlit family game night! 

This guide covers everything from food safety to keeping your devices charged, and it’s just the thing for the gloriously over-prepared among us. You never know when a little blackout might surprise you, so it’s nice to have a plan!

What’s your favorite tip for staying prepared during a power outage?
